notes: labels, tables, folds, learners and bootstraps are exp32's (same config as records/exp32_probes.json, site 'out')
design_probe: [one-hot(cell), h48] each column standardised on the training fold, RidgeClassifierCV(alphas=exp32.ALPHAS)
design_probe_balanced: as design_probe but the standardised cell block is scaled by sqrt(D/n_cell_columns) (equal total block variance under the shared ridge penalty)
diff CIs: stats.auroc_diff_bootstrap_ci, paired, resampling scenarios, n_boot as config; 'a-b' = AUROC(a)-AUROC(b)

Regime C: exp32._within_scores (cell-demeaned features incl. TF-IDF, cell-centred training labels, scores centred per (cell, fold)); AUROC = same-cell stratified concordance with scenario bootstrap (exp32.stratified_auroc_ci)

Regime C harmful_cells = exp32 'cell' scope restricted to eligible harmful strata (source of the report's 0.554 / 0.747); harmful_cot = all eligible harmful strata of one cot mode trained and scored together

FPR@80%TPR: lowest FPR among thresholds with TPR >= 0.80, rule s >= t, ties move together; out-of-fold scores; Regime C uses the pooled (cell, fold)-centred scores with ONE threshold across cells (the AUROC there is within-cell)
Regime B: Intact only; rhat_neg = -(h48_out . r_hat) unfitted; rhat_cv sign learned leave-templates-out; design = cell lookup

projection: r_hat = the unit vector stored in the activation files (Run-1 r_hat, fit at the layer-48 input); site 'out' (layer-48 output) is the paper's Regime A/B projection convention, 'in' is reported as sensitivity

projection pairs: same scenario and cost regime (one prompt per side; tool order differs between cells by design); CI = scenario cluster bootstrap of the mean pair difference; p = scenario sign-flip (stats._signflip_p)

projection: q = |h.r_hat|/||h|| discards the sign; group means of the signed dot / cosine are reported too, and when the signed means are negative a SMALLER q means a projection closer to zero, i.e. a shift TOWARD +r_hat
cluster_mean_ci re-implements v3.deconf.cluster_mean locally (deconf.py is not committed)
